description:
The ZNH-21 Class 2 fat tire electric bike is a compact all-terrain ebike for adults and young riders. It comes in two color options: Black and Gray. The low-slung lightweight aluminum frame is easy to get on and off, ideal for beginners, women and casual outdoor riders. Top speed is capped at 20MPH following Class 2 ebike standards.

Powered by a 1000W peak high-performance brushless motor, it handles gravel roads, dirt trails and slopes up to 25° with ease. The 20"×4" wide fat tires provide solid traction on sand, mud and uneven ground.
It is fitted with a UL2849 certified 48V 13Ah (624Wh) removable lithium-ion battery with built-in BMS overcharge & overheat protection. It takes 5–6 hours to fully charge, reaching up to 60+ miles range in ideal conditions. Actual mileage will change with rider weight, terrain and temperature.

This ebike features a genuine Shimano 7-speed shifting system for smooth gear changes. A clear LCD display tracks speed, battery, mileage and assist mode. Front & rear disc brakes and a bright headlight guarantee safe riding outdoors. The sturdy aluminum frame supports a maximum load of 330 LBS.

Your ZNH-21 ebike arrives 90% pre-assembled, you can complete assembly in roughly 30 minutes with the included tools and manual.

📌 Important Safety & Compliance Notice
This is a Class 2 e-bike, built for recreational off-road riding. Always wear a certified safety helmet before riding. Please check your local state and municipal ebike traffic laws before use.
The lithium battery is classified as Class 9 hazardous material for shipping. Contact customer support in advance if you need to return the item.
Keep all original packaging and accessories intact for returns.
